title: English Heritage opens the Stonehenge stone circle to everyone, free, at the winter solstice
alt: A single tall, rough standing stone in grassland, with the ring of stones and visitors far off on the horizon under a cloudy sky.

posts.facebook:
English Heritage opens the stone circle at Stonehenge to everyone, free, for the winter solstice, this year on Tuesday 22 December. Anyone coming by car must pre-book parking or be turned away, so plan to travel through Salisbury by public transport. Dress for a cold night outdoors and check English Heritage's list of items that are not allowed.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/visit-a-stone-circle-at-solstice/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do

Photo: Andy Li, CC0 (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en), via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Heel_Stone_and_Stonehenge_2025-07-23.jpg (cropped).
